name: Membership and Equivalence Queries Complexity of Singletons
proof: For $n=1$, the target is known without a query. For $n\ge2$, query the all-zero labeling. Every singleton target disagrees with it only at its unique positive coordinate, so any counterexample identifies the target. Zero queries cannot distinguish the $n$ possible targets. Arbitrary equivalence queries are allowed in the mixed model; adding membership queries cannot improve on zero or one.
